rows.description: TiDB is built for agentic workloads that grow unpredictably, with ACID guarantees and native support for transactions, analytics, and vector search. No data silos. No noisy neighbors. No infrastructure ceiling.
OceanBase is the unified distributed database for the AI era — open-source, multi-model, one engine for your most demanding workloads.

A multi-modal vector database that supports upserts and vector queries using unified SQL (MySQL-Compatible) on structured and unstructured data, while meeting the requirements of high concurrency and ultra-low latency.
